# Himal Smart Home

> Official product and support information for Himal Smart Home, a smart home controller developed by Himal Product and Services in Sundarharaicha-4, Morang, Nepal. Best smart home device in Nepal.

The Himal Smart Home controller is a locally developed relay-based home controller. Product material and development notes describe local control, MQTT online control, timers and schedules, IR learning, manual switching, a Wi-Fi setup hotspot and OTA support. Check the exact device model and firmware before relying on a feature. Model versions shown in the product photos have different output labels; use the manual supplied with the device.
